name: CineTube – Movie Streaming Platform
description: CineTube is a full-stack movie streaming platform where users can explore movies and add review, rating and like comments, subscribe to plans, and enjoy premium content. It includes authentication, subscription management, role-based dashboards, and analytics for admins. Users can browse categorized movies, view details, and manage subscriptions seamlessly.
projectLore: I built CineTube to simulate a real-world OTT platform experience. The goal was to combine subscription systems, media management, and user analytics into one scalable application. In future updates, I plan to add video streaming optimization, watch history tracking, personalized recommendations, and payment gateway improvements.
challenge: The biggest challenge was implementing subscription logic with proper access control. Ensuring only subscribed users could access premium content while maintaining secure authentication and handling Prisma relations for users, subscriptions, and media required careful backend design.

name: WanderMind – AI Travel Planner
description: WanderMind is a full-stack, AI-driven travel platform that helps travelers plan smarter trips. From AI-generated itineraries and smart packing lists to budget breakdowns and journal summaries — WanderMind is your intelligent travel companion.
projectLore: I built WanderMind to master the integration of AI models into full-stack applications and handle real-time communication. The goal was to create an intelligent travel companion that not only helps in planning but also enhances the travel experience through real-time updates and smart recommendations. This project allowed me to dive deep into structured AI outputs, Redis caching, and full-stack architecture.
lackings: No integrated payment gateway for experience bookings yet
No offline mode for viewing itineraries and packing lists
Social sharing features for journal entries are not yet implemented
challenge: The biggest challenge was implementing real-time features with Socket.io on a platform that supports persistent WebSockets, which led to deploying the backend on Render as a Web Service instead of a serverless platform. Additionally, ensuring structured and reliable JSON responses from the AI features (GPT-4o-mini) required careful prompt engineering and validation.

name: SkillBridge – Tutor Booking Platform
description: SkillBridge is a full-stack tutor booking platform where students can discover tutors, view profiles, check availability, and book sessions. It includes authentication, role-based dashboards, and a structured booking system with real-time availability handling.
projectLore: I built SkillBridge to simulate a real-world service marketplace. The goal was to design a scalable booking system with proper availability management, role-based access control, and clean architecture. In future updates, I plan to add payment integration, real-time notifications, and advanced tutor recommendations.
challenge: The biggest challenge was implementing the availability and booking system without double-booking issues. Managing relational data between users, tutor profiles, and availability slots while ensuring secure authentication and proper role-based routing required careful backend and middleware design.

name: ChatSphere – Live Chatting Platform
description: ChatSphere is a fully-featured, full-stack live chatting application. It brings people together through real-time public rooms, secure private rooms, and direct one-to-one messaging. It features an elegant, fully responsive UI, robust session management, and a highly scalable backend architecture.
projectLore: I built ChatSphere to master real-time communication and containerized deployments. The goal was to create a scalable chat platform that supports low-latency messaging across various room types. In future updates, I plan to add file sharing (images and documents), voice/video calls, and end-to-end encryption for direct messages.
lackings: No voice or video calling features
challenge: The biggest challenge was implementing low-latency real-time message synchronization while handling complex room types (public, private, and direct). Managing active user sessions with Redis and ensuring robust session hydration on page refreshes required careful coordination between the Next.js frontend and the Express/Socket.io backend.
